64f83bcdde58fc437700d8fa: Mechanic has a rare and expensive thermal-marksman commission. Build the suppressed SR-25 to the client’s exacting specifications without losing the unusual FLIR.
64f83bd983cfca080a362c82: An outrageous customer wants a PKP transformed into a fully dressed Zenitco showpiece. Build the heavy machine gun to Mechanic’s specifications and somehow keep it usable.
655e427b64d09b4122018228: A mysterious ‘Master’ believes you deserve the attention of his group and is preparing for darker times. Harvest experienced PMCs across Tarkov and bring their dogtags to Peacekeeper.
6572e876dc0d635f633a5714: Skier has an action-movie plan to rob the city—or at least see which cash machines remain intact. Survey the scattered ATMs across Streets for a future score.
657315ddab5a49b71f098853: Therapist is judging whether a new mercenary can be useful. Find Ground Zero’s Emercom station for a possible evacuation and bring her a few medical supplies you scavenged yourself.
657315df034d76585f032e01: Prapor’s first test is part reconnaissance, part target practice. Find Ground Zero’s heavy machine-gun and grenade-launcher positions, then clear the nearby threats.
657315e1dccd301f1301416a: Prapor wants a rare French wine as a goodwill gift for a wealthy collector. Search Ground Zero’s overpriced liquor store and make sure the bottle is genuine.
657315e270bb0b8dba00cc48: Skier needs a quiet message whispered to one of his city drivers where nobody can overhear. Take the paid SUV out of Ground Zero and pass it along during the ride.
657315e4a6af4ab4b50f3459: Mechanic wants to know what happened to a TerraGroup scientist marked for death. Search the Ground Zero complex, trace the USEC team, and bring back the scientist’s hard drive.
65733403eefc2c312a759ddb: Mechanic still uses remarkably good software made by a tiny prewar IT firm and suspects there was a sinister secret behind its productivity. Find the office and investigate.
6573382e557ff128bf3da536: The torture room explains the IT firm’s stick, but not its carrot. Dig deeper into the office and discover how management kept its employees unnaturally enthusiastic.
6573387d0b26ed4fde798de3: The veterinary leads were not enough for Therapist’s supply effort. Check three city pharmacies and make it back with a report before she sends collectors in.
6573397ef3f8344c4575cd87: Prapor suspects the city’s land registry exposes TerraGroup facilities hidden behind respectable paperwork. Find the real-estate fund and steal its cadastral records.
65734c186dc1e402c80dc19e: A fashionable gang is interfering with Ragman’s business. Dress like one of them, cause a murderous scandal on Streets, then plant the outfit at their barbershop so they take the blame.
6574e0dedc0d635f633a5805: Prapor has another Russian weapon awaiting field data. Take his scoped RPDN to Shoreline and put the belt-fed machine gun through a proper combat trial.
6578eb36e5020875d64645cd: Kollontay was a crooked cop before the disaster and now rules part of Streets from the MVD academy. Kill him and his guards, and bring Jaeger the police baton as proof.
6578ec473dbd035d04531a8d: Mechanic thinks Woods’ abandoned weather stations still have working power supplies for his transmitters. Find all five and mark them for his installation crew.
658027799634223183395339: Skier’s smuggler friends fled their Shoreline base and left the contraband behind. Find the camp and punish the looters helping themselves to it.
65802b627b44fa5e14638899: Ragman paid for a running SUV, sent it to Shoreline, and then lost both car and driver. Track down the vehicle and return with an explanation.
6603fe74e773dcf3b0099f88: Encrypted flash drives are suddenly appearing around Tarkov as though someone planted them. Find one among the electronics and let Skier see what mystery it contains.
6613f3007f6666d56807c929: Ragman’s planned WARTECH production line was scattered by Raiders. Break their grip on the supply chain and recover a bulk load of the brand’s field gear.
6613f307fca4f2f386029409: The new line is thriving, so Ragman wants to expand into LBT equipment. Raid the Rogues who control the stock and bring back enough branded gear to launch the range.
66151401efb0539ae10875ae: Another version of Ragman’s WARTECH venture needs a truly industrial supply run. Tear into the Raiders responsible for the shortage and reclaim their branded equipment.
6615141bfda04449120269a7: Ragman’s follow-up expansion depends on LBT kit held by the Rogues. Turn their losses into a warehouse-sized shipment of rigs, carriers, and packs.
6658a15615cbb1b2c6014d5b: A freak gathering has brought nearly every major boss in Tarkov to Reserve. Jaeger wants you to exploit the brief opportunity and hunt the entire collection.
665eeacf5d86b6c8aa03c79b: Sanitar’s people are prowling Shoreline after dark, apparently searching for something. Disrupt their night patrols while Jaeger works out what drew them there.
665eec1f5e47a79f8605565a: Skier once worked with the hard-drinking scavenger known as Thirsty and knows where he cached supplies. First, pay for the tip with two propane tanks found in raid.
665eec4a4dfc83b0ed0a9dca: Skier keeps his bargain by turning those propane tanks into a delivery job. Hide one near the Woods radio bunker and the other in the Customs crossroads store to earn the next clue.
665eeca45d86b6c8aa03c79d: Therapist and Sanitar are both chasing Thirsty because his past may connect to TerraGroup. Reach his Shoreline hideout first and bring her the battered diary.
665eeca92f7aedcc900b0437: Thirsty’s diary describes a combat stimulant he used constantly. Therapist can recreate it, but first needs fresh adrenaline, vitamins, and saline for the formula.
66631489acf8442f8b05319f: Fence may have serious work for you, but first wants proof you recognize his people. Kill PMCs without harming a single Scav.
6663148ca9290f9e0806cca1: One of Fence’s scouts died after visiting the white chalk circles, leaving no usable toxin sample. Get poisoned there yourself and survive long enough to extract with it active.
6663148ed7f171c4c20226c1: A Scav entrepreneur has been using Fence’s routes to sell souvenir figurines to cultists. Collect the strange range of figures so Fence can inspect what may be hidden inside.
6663149196a9349baa021baa: Fence traced the unauthorized business to one of Tarkov’s bosses. Cut down the bosses’ guards as a warning, but leave their useful leaders alive.
66631493312343839d032d22: Cultists bought Fence’s product behind his back. Leave their own knives at four marked circles across Woods and Shoreline to remind them who controls trade in Tarkov.
6663149cfd5ca9577902e037: Ragman’s competitors are stealing customers and moving stock through heavily loaded couriers. Target the mules carrying conspicuously large backpacks.
6663149f1d3ec95634095e75: The rival supply line is weakened, but Ragman needs real market momentum. Feed a major volume of backpacks and tactical rigs through his shop to get trade circulating.
666314a1920800278d0f6746: Demand is rising and Ragman wants an exclusive display instead of ordinary stock. Bring him a collection of rare bags and boss-edition rigs found in the field.
666314a31cd52e3d040a2e76: Ragman’s new Goons-inspired equipment looks convincing, but appearance is not enough. Wear it against Tarkov’s bosses and prove the line survives real combat.
666314a50aa5c7436c00908a: Success has Ragman nostalgic for old business—and inspired to enlarge your pockets with an expensive vintage pattern. Pay him a small fortune in physical Bitcoins for the tailoring.
666314b0acf8442f8b0531a1: Prapor’s nephew loves a game about shooting demons, so he wants the perfect gift. Turn a shortened double-barrel MP-43 into something suitably brutal and iconic.
666314b2a9290f9e0806cca3: The demon-slaying shotgun never made it across the border, but Tarkov has demons of its own. Take the double barrel out at night and hunt cultists with it.
666314b4d7f171c4c20226c3: Prapor misses the old Factory days when one PMC kit seemed to be everywhere. Recreate that classic loadout and see how it fares against modern opposition.
666314b696a9349baa021bac: Prapor’s nostalgia reminds Therapist how much rare equipment once came out of TerraGroup’s Lab. Recover an original American LEDX for her medical work.
666314b8312343839d032d24: Airdrops have brought components Mechanic could never otherwise obtain. Test whether the pilots still answer a red flare by calling a package to the old Woods sawmill.
666314bafd5ca9577902e03a: The Factory throwback has Prapor remembering when Reshala’s golden TT was the ultimate status symbol. Remind Tarkov what it can do in a firefight.
666314bc1d3ec95634095e77: Skier heard ULTRA contains a special magazine issue celebrating a Russian video game famous worldwide. Find the collectible and bring it to him.
666314bd920800278d0f6748: Prapor has discovered that people outside Tarkov watch the conflict live and likes the idea of extra eyes. Establish camera coverage on Woods, Shoreline, and Factory.
666314bf1cd52e3d040a2e78: A client wants the hard drive used to accuse a game studio of stealing millions of accounts. Recover it from the old Shoreline house so the allegation can be examined.
666314c10aa5c7436c00908c: A documentary crew is determined to film Tarkov, but its airdropped equipment was damaged. Scrounge a broad set of electronics and camera-repair parts so Mechanic can keep them alive and working.
666314c3acf8442f8b0531a3: Prapor’s new surveillance network ruined one of Skier’s deals. Mock the ‘rooster’ by leaving golden rooster figurines beside his cameras on three maps.
666314c5a9290f9e0806cca5: Ragman has learned Tarkov’s ceremonial city key may still exist as a museum piece. Recover the unique souvenir from Streets before another collector gets rich from it.
6672d9def1c88688a707d042: Fence is open to a deeper partnership, but only after your reputation proves you are dependable. Earn the level of trust his network demands.
6672ec2a2b6f3b71be794cc5: Therapist says access to every section of TerraGroup’s Lab is now a matter of life and death. Assemble the full set of colored keycards and a standard entry pass for her.
668bcccc167d507eb01a268b: Peacekeeper and Prapor’s price war has flooded Factory Scavs with ruined western guns. Kill the armed middlemen and bring Mechanic several battered imports as evidence of the dumping.
668bccf963acb16d63707043: Peacekeeper refuses to accept rumours that his western merchandise is defective. Hand over a larger sample of the nearly destroyed imported weapons so he can trace their source.
668bcd1b194be70f18427a00: Peacekeeper traced the faulty-gun scheme to Rogues using outside dealers. Put cameras on all three treatment-plant entrances and watch who comes to collect their stock.
669fa38fad7f1eac2607ed46: An influential client wants a TerraGroup journal quietly removed from Factory. Recover it and bury the loose end at the old Woods sawmill rather than letting Therapist see it.
669fa3910c828825de06d69f: Therapist believes TerraGroup’s eagerness to hide the Factory journal proves it matters to Tarkov’s citizens. Defy the disposal order and place the evidence in her care instead.
669fa394e0c9f9fafa082897: Mechanic wants to build a forklift for his enlarged warehouse playground. Map every surviving machine around Factory so his crew can salvage the necessary parts.
669fa395c4c5c04798002497: Factory is getting too crowded for Skier’s comfort. Scout the main exit as a dependable fallback and prove the route by escaping through it.
669fa3979b0ce3feae01a130: Jaeger wants cramped tunnels to become an advantage rather than a panic trap. Take a shotgun into Factory’s old cellars and master the close-quarters fight.
669fa399033a3ce9870338a8: Factory’s crashed helicopter makes no sense to Prapor; nobody was supposed to be extracting people by air. Recover the pilot’s logbook and uncover its real mission.
669fa39b91b0a8c9680fc467: Mechanic expects a platinum crisis and knows old Factory heat exchangers contain valuable Soviet-era inserts. Mark all three before his partners move in to salvage them.
669fa39c64ea11e84c0642a6: The expanded Factory is too interesting for Skier to leave unwatched. Install cameras in the three crane cabs and give him eyes over the grounds.
669fa39ee749756c920d02c8: A damaged Factory tank is leaking something absent from Polikhim’s official paperwork. Take a chemical sample so Therapist can judge the danger to the city.
669fa3a08b4a64b332041ff7: Jaeger learned TerraGroup hid a vial of rare, dangerous material beneath Factory. Secure the chemical container before competing traders or killers discover it.
669fa3a1c26f13bd04030f37: Mechanic’s partners have a use for Factory’s old reactor mixers, but their motors are dead. Repair all three machines with toolsets and give the plan a chance.
669fa3a3ad7f1eac2607ed48: Factory workers have been found dead without visible injuries, suggesting poisoning or something worse. Take a blood sample from one victim so Therapist can continue tracing Tarkov’s unexplained deaths.
669fa3a40c828825de06d6a1: Prapor has a light imported UZI PRO that needs the most intimate kind of field test. Take the specified build into Factory and use it at point-blank range.
66a74c628410476dd65543be: A mercenary team preparing to raid The Lab needs dependable firepower. Build Mechanic a highly controllable, ergonomic M4A1 around the client’s preferred EOTech sight.
66a75b44243a6548ff5e5ff9: After a client disappeared into The Lab without paying, Mechanic is reconsidering how he sells weapons. Field-test the major Russian and western calibres to guide his ready-made gun packages.
66a77394243a6548ff5e601d: Drifters severed Mechanic’s long-distance supplier links just as he was planning new orders. Scrounge enough communications hardware to rebuild the connection.
66a78dada472ad7f845b71f7: Mechanic predicts another phase of the conflict and is running a wildly ambitious market survey. Keep using whatever becomes your favourite weapon while his tracker measures its popularity over the long haul.
66aa58245ab22944110db6e9: Peacekeeper needs an old USEC supply shortcut from TerraGroup headquarters to Rodina reopened. Scout the Ground Zero approach, transit into Streets, and verify the destination in one continuous run.
66aa61663aa37705c5024277: Ragman discovered smugglers moving goods from Streets to ULTRA with impossible speed. Fight through both ends of their hidden transit route in one raid and claim it for his business.
66aa74571e5e199ecd094f18: Mechanic’s workers found precision instruments at Customs that he needs inside Polikhim. Carry the case through the industrial shortcut to Factory, clear the laboratory, and stash it in storage.
66ab970848ddbe9d4a0c49a8: Prapor’s people urgently need communications along a secret Woods-to-Reserve trail once used by an elusive mushroom picker. Lay cable equipment at both ends of the transit route.
66ab9da7eb102b9bcd08591c: Looters are pushing deeper into the forests along an old swamp path only Jaeger knew. Clear the villages on both sides of the Lighthouse-to-Shoreline route in one journey.
66aba85403e0ee3101042877: Therapist has heard an old bomb shelter connects Streets directly to TerraGroup’s Lab. Traverse the hidden passage, reconnoitre the key laboratory sections, and locate the route back.
66b38c7bf85b8bf7250f9cb6: Jaeger thinks growing confidence has made you careless around explosives. Inspect a notorious minefield on Woods and a Claymore on Ground Zero before complacency kills you.
66b38e144f2ab7cc530c3fe7: Tripwires require a hunter’s instinct, not random placement. Study where prey moves and identify convincing ambush positions on Factory and Customs for Jaeger.
66d9cbb67b491f9d5304f6e6: Fence’s bored outside client has compiled a sprawling tour of suspiciously familiar scenes across Tarkov. Plant cameras at the many pop-culture reference spots and humour his very specific jokes.
66e01aca214f88109006a4b5: Mortars have begun striking several regions of Tarkov. Prapor wants someone reckless enough to enter an active bombardment zone and see what is really happening.
66e01ad15a8890455a0d9eea: The mortar crates contain valuable military electronics, and Prapor wants both the contents and less competition. Recover radar spares from the drops while thinning out PMCs around the strike zones.
66e01ad6835f78499f049180: Rogues intercepted government electronic-warfare equipment at the treatment plant. Storm their operation, reclaim the portable devices, and deal with the Goons and their fighters guarding the haul.
66e01adbd3d014f3ae061c12: Prapor is equipping remote teams with the new radar and jamming hardware. Deliver the components to concealed positions at the Woods sawmill and Shoreline weather station.
66e01ae0c391e4c94903d220: Lightkeeper is expecting a top-tier jammer from a covert airdrop. Obtain the KOSA device, carry it directly from Shoreline to Lighthouse, and hide it in the yacht-club cottage without breaking the run.
66e01c4c475acf7e0102d296: Prapor fears enemies mastering mortars and electronic warfare at the same time. Build him a strategic reserve of radar spares and portable jammers before the next escalation.
66e3e2ee2136472d220bcb36: Cultists are appearing better armed and rumours speak of an invincible night creature called the Oni. Hunt the hooded figures and find out whether something larger is organizing them.
66e3e2fcb26de0e0790d3fe6: Partisan overheard that a Harbinger is directing the cultists toward a new ritual, while an Oni and a Ghost stalk the chaos. Kill all three horrors before the ceremony claims more victims.
670404a2ea1caa8f2e0be106: Stories of bleeding living dead emerging from The Lab sound absurd, but the witnesses look genuinely broken. Trace the rumours and find a way into the quarantined section.
67040b3d10b18d153a08f636: Jaeger will reluctantly work with Therapist if it can stop the infection. Recover a fresh blood sample from the infected in The Lab so they have something real to study.
67040b6c45eaf70db10dbec6: The contagion is spreading above ground faster than a cure can be developed. Jaeger wants the infected culled wherever they appear before they overwhelm the survivors.
67040ba4578a46e44a05c0a8: The infected blood is not enough to design an antidote. Extract the TG-Vi-24 virus itself from The Lab and deliver it to Therapist with as little exposure as possible.
67040c22cc1f3752720376e9: Mechanic located a TerraGroup office computer that may still hold outbreak data. Install his prepared drive at the Cardinal workstation and keep the connection alive long enough to copy it.
67040c43ce929d6ee506c7c7: The copied files point to Vladimir O., a secret project scientist who likely kept personal records. Open the sealed virus room in The Lab and retrieve his signed diary.
67040c5b4ac6d9c18c0ade26: Until Therapist produces a cure, Jaeger wants the infected dispatched with certainty. Use shotgun headshots to stop them cleanly before they can close the distance.
67040c78bf4be8a4ef041a65: Vladimir secretly developed an antidote before becoming the project’s first victim. Recover prototype Sample IV from The Lab, carry it into Streets, and leave it beneath Kaban’s office for Therapist’s team.
67040c92bf4be8a4ef041a6c: Jaeger’s elderly friend survived, proving the outbreak has not claimed everyone. Purge the infected from Ground Zero, Streets, and The Lab to protect those still holding on.
67040cae4ac6d9c18c0ade2c: Therapist finalized a vaccine that kills both virus and patient, seeing it as the only way to protect the uninfected. Disperse it through Tarkov’s water systems without killing Sanitar during the operation.
67040ccdcc1f3752720376ef: Jaeger believes Therapist and Sanitar hid a survivable cure for themselves. Raid Sanitar’s office, recover the true vaccine recipe, and kill the doctor—choosing this path over Therapist’s lethal plan.
67190f6c1b3f4964d90d71e9: If the Shoreline outbreak reaches the harbor, panicked civilians could carry it beyond Norvinsk and Russia. Help Peacekeeper’s port security reduce the infected before escape becomes possible.
67190f9c7b0991dc22064766: Lightkeeper is too important to Tarkov’s balance of power to be lost during the epidemic. Fence wants the infected around Lighthouse cleared while its guards are overstretched.
67190febcce4a5fdf605d4f8: Reserve is suffering repeated infected breakthroughs. Prapor wants you on high ground, cutting them down at range before the horde can close in.
67191048eddf081d340d4c6e: Firearm demand is stripping Tarkov’s stockpiles down toward handguns. Mechanic wants pistols and revolvers tested against the infected in Factory’s unforgiving close quarters.
671910d5dbd4354ac10e9784: Jaeger fears the virus could linger in Woods’ soil and poison the reserve itself. Hunt the infected there at night and drive them out of the forest.
671a49f77d49aea42c029b5f: A shipment of instantly recognizable movie shotguns vanished near ULTRA. Find the stolen weapon case for Skier before the exclusive cargo disappears into someone else’s collection.
671a59e43d73dac1360765cc: Customers dismiss Skier’s exotic Auto Assault-12s as flimsy movie props. Put on a violent demonstration with the shotgun and make the market take it seriously.
6727ef2c6015b7cc540ea754: The infection has reached Tagilla, turning an already unstoppable brute into its most dangerous carrier. Kill him decisively and survive long enough to confirm he stays down.
673f2cd5d3346c2167020484: The BTR Driver’s depot was ransacked, leaving Prapor’s urgent package stranded somewhere near the Woods sawmill. Search the warehouses, office, and garages while Mechanic helps recover the cargo.
673f348dd3346c21670217e7: Prapor’s delayed military shipment has finally been recovered from the Woods depot. Hand over the package now; his reckoning with the driver can wait.
673f4e956f1b89c7bc0f56ef: Raiders stole even the spare wheels from the BTR Driver’s depot. Track down a genuine replacement set and mark the right one quickly—guessing wrong will waste the job.
673f5a4976553f78350bdac1: The first wheel search failed and the BTR is close to being stranded. Find the properly sized replacement wheels on Reserve and mark them without another mistake.
673f6027352b4da8e00322d2: The depot thieves came from Reserve and may still be following the old forest route home. Chase them from Woods into the military base and punish both ends of the gang.
673f61a066e6a521aa04b62b: Lightkeeper refuses to take sides in the BTR dispute, but wants a KOSA jammer moved through it. Carry the device from Reserve’s electromechanical warehouse to a Woods cemetery stash.
673f629c5b555b53460cf827: The BTR Driver wants out from under Skier but needs another trader’s protection before he can break away. Demonstrate useful business volume with Ragman and help establish that relationship.
6740a02a69a58fceba0ff399: The depot attack left the BTR Driver dangerously short of fuel. Deliver empty metal cans to the Shoreline smugglers, who will refill them as part of a quiet exchange.
6740a15566e6a521aa051b15: Prapor may back the BTR Driver against Skier, but wants proof everyone is committed. Recover an outside shipment waiting near Norvinsk’s port and bring it to him.
6740a2c17e3818d5bb0648b6: Prapor’s promised shipment arrived half empty, yet he still needs the electronics before helping the driver. Replace the missing military and computer components from your own raids.
6740a3f4eca8acb2d2055159: Someone—possibly Skier—is flooding Prapor’s men with fresh attackers while he negotiates with the BTR Driver. Remove the pressure so the alliance can move forward.
6740b60c60a98cad1b0e0aa0: Ragman sees value in the BTR Driver’s transport, but cannot take the risk while one of his courier crews is missing. Find their trail on Woods and return with news.
674492b6909d2013670a347a: The BTR Driver remembers a narrow cliff route that Ragman’s couriers could use around Lighthouse. Walk the old path and mark its four sections for a new trade lane.
6744a4717e3818d5bb0680bb: Ragman identified the Scavs who killed his couriers and wants the debt settled before helping the driver. Hit the gang on Ground Zero and make it out alive.
6744a728352b4da8e003eda9: Prapor is still considering the alliance, but the BTR may fail before negotiations finish. Find the Driver a military tank battery to keep its electronics alive.
6744a9dfef61d56e020b5c4a: Ragman is taking his time with the deal while the BTR’s electrical system deteriorates. Bring the Driver a heavy military battery before the vehicle becomes useless.
6744ab1def61d56e020b5c56: The BTR Driver is building a new base and fears Skier is already watching. Quietly recover the KOSA jammer hidden at the Woods cemetery and deliver it as air-defense insurance.
6744aca8d3346c216702c583: Skier has stockpiled RPGs to destroy the BTR. Follow the Driver’s Woods route, find all three firing-position crates, and turn their ammunition into explosive traps.
6744af0969a58fceba101fed: The BTR Driver has one chance to break free: plant kompromat on Skier, create diversions through Woods and Lighthouse, and survive the entire Customs-to-coast operation without interruption.
6745cbee909d2013670a4a55: Freedom from Skier depends on a complicated one-run deception. Move an incriminating letter through Reserve, draw pursuit across Woods, signal twice at Lighthouse, and escape with the Driver’s plan intact.
6745fae369a58fceba10343d: Skier has noticed PMCs supporting his ambitious BTR ‘mule.’ Remove the Driver’s helpers around Woods before the rebellion attracts more allies.
6745fcded0fbbc74ca0f721d: With fresh wheels fitted, the BTR Driver can finally answer the depot raid. Hunt down the Woods Scavs who robbed his base.
6745fdddd3346c216702e0bf: Lightkeeper offers a neutral courier job amid the feud. Move his sealed case from Reserve’s hospital roof to the Woods Scav house without opening or losing it.
674600a366e6a521aa05eb66: Skier knows the BTR Driver is testing unauthorized routes through the city. Mark every Streets stop so his men can track where the vehicle goes and why.
674602307e3818d5bb069489: The Driver’s allies may expose Skier’s stash network, so he needs a replacement depot under the Woods mountain. Find the bunker and stock it with Russian armor-piercing ammunition.
6746053b5b555b53460d9896: Skier suspects Peacekeeper may become the BTR Driver’s new patron. Push a serious volume of trade through Peacekeeper to remind him which partnership should matter.
674605df60a98cad1b0ec799: Skier has secured RPG ammunition capable of piercing the BTR and wants the Driver’s rebellion ended. Retrieve the hidden rocket package from the Woods Scav house.
67460662d0fbbc74ca0f7229: Skier’s RPG assault failed, so he wants the Driver’s growing network smashed directly. Fight along the full Customs–Reserve–Woods–Lighthouse route and finish the continuous raid alive.
675031be899713ccad00060c: Prapor’s officers are planning a proper Christmas dinner, but the warehouses hold only stew and potatoes. Supply everything missing for Olivier salad and a few serious toasts.
675031d3884e1da4a90b3bc9: Jaeger says extreme cold can ruin a shooter before the enemy does. Prove you can still fight effectively while your hands are suffering from frostbite.
675031e1f300496cc4104450: Ragman sees the holiday fairs as perfect cover for moving merchandise. Visit the decorated trees across the region so he can add their coordinates to his routes.
675031f57775aada6b0f96a1: Prapor insists that fighting spirit needs something human to hold onto. Build a Christmas tree in the Hideout even if Tarkov hardly feels festive.
6750320e23fc8fd9cc087d14: Holiday revelers have tried stealing fuel from Skier’s depots. Dress as Ded Moroz or Santa and make an unmistakably festive example of the PMC thieves.
67503219527c9a38e80496ae: Christmas tree poachers are cutting old growth across Tarkov’s forests. Help Jaeger defend the reserves by hunting the nighttime intruders wherever the woods spread.
67503247622398376d0b57cd: Prapor wants every decorated tree lit in one citywide celebration, with armed crews defending the generators as they move. Join the Khorovod procession and carry it through to Interchange.
67503260899713ccad00060e: Killa and festively dressed Scavs intercepted Ragman’s holiday shipment inside ULTRA. Hit their nighttime party, kill its host, and clear the masked gang.
6752f6d83038f7df520c83e8: Mechanic values the stranded BTR Driver as one of Tarkov’s few remaining technical minds. Recover Prapor’s package from the Woods depot and help reconcile the delayed delivery.
675c03d1f7da9792a405549a: TerraGroup inexplicably abandoned a shipment near the Customs terminal despite possible records and medical samples inside. Locate and mark all seven branded cargo groups for Therapist.
675c047fa46173572a0bd878: Therapist suspects TerraGroup’s Customs cargo may contain something dangerous, but her people can’t reach it. Search the customs offices for the shipment report and bring her the paper trail.
675c04f4db8807b75d0f38e8: The manifest was scrubbed and Therapist’s team has gone silent. Retrace the delivery crew’s stops on Customs and recover their notes before whatever happened to them goes unexplained.
675c085d59b0575973005f52: Ragman wants Reshala’s new business deal ruined before it starts. Restock the sniper’s Customs hide with a complete DVL-10 kit so the meeting can be crashed.
675c1570526ff496850895d9: Mechanic remembers a friend who obsessed over shaving millimeters off every tool. Search his old Customs garage for the customized tool set or any clue to what became of him.

67af4c1cc0e59d55e2010b97: Luka has vanished with the operation’s profits, leaving Skier furious and humiliated. For now, his only plan is to drown the lesson in vodka, whiskey and moonshine.
67af4c1d8c9482eca103e477: Skier thinks Raiders moved an evacuated stash into The Lab. Keep the place clear through repeated raids so his specialists can search for something worth salvaging.
67b45467814ab0ffa000c7e7: Prapor has access to heavier explosives but won’t sell them to an amateur. Prove you can put grenades and launchers on target without blowing up yourself or your squad.
67d03be712fb5f8fd2096332: Ragman’s technicians want the valuable equipment left in the Labyrinth, but they can’t fight. Clear the cellars so his people can move in and pack everything properly.

67f3eaa3a7799274d50a8b66: Jaeger believes Skier’s potential recruits need a warning, not handouts. Hit the charity checkpoints across Tarkov and wipe out the recruiters before the locals start trusting them.
67f3eab9a33cd296b20ee695: Skier’s recruitment network is being mauled by Partisan and hostile mercs. Protect the operation by hunting Partisan down and thinning out the PMCs backing the disruption.
67f3eacef649e7bceb0bb455: With Skier’s stations moving too fast to stop, Jaeger opts for terror. Use Partisan’s near-instant F-1 grenades to make bandit work look like a very bad career choice.

6834158f2f0e2a7eb90b62c8: Ref’s Arena is expanding faster than its concessions. Scrounge up food and drinks for the next crowd and earn your place on his staff.
68341846186efa3c5b07f989: Ref promotes you to equipment tester and has a cheap batch of AUGs to evaluate. Try one on a few Scavs so he knows whether it belongs with gladiators or cleaners.
68341a0b2f0e2a7eb90b62d4: Next, Ref wants to know whether basic PACA armor is good enough for his cleanup crew. Wear it into real fights with PMCs and provide a practical answer.
68341b407559f4e6d50bc0ce: Ref wants to surprise the crowd by toughening up a regular performer. Bring him a few serious armor plates for the upgrade.
68341c4babec72d95d0c1260: Ref’s co-founders are muscling their own champion into the Arena. Plant inert TNT in a Ground Zero café to scare Kaban and Kollontay without actually blowing the place up.

68341eb25619c8e2a9031501: Ref thinks you could be his next champion. Win an Arena match and show that his offer is more than empty hype.
68341f6fe2e7ef70a3060a0a: Ref has put you under his wing, but overseas sponsors need a reason to notice. Win another proper team match and make it entertaining enough to draw their bets.

68342446a8d674b5740b31fc: Ref knows you visited the old champion’s apartment and would rather redirect your curiosity into violence. Bury the issue under a long stretch of Arena combat.
6834254f2f0e2a7eb90b62ef: Ref has heard about your investigation and wants proof of loyalty. Recover the compromising material from the old champion’s trail and hand it directly to the man it incriminates.
683425dd8f5b18d29a05d9d1: Fence says the dead champion kept a journal that can stop you becoming the Arena’s next disposable star. Return to the hideout, recover the dirt on Ref, and sell it to Fence instead.
683427418f5b18d29a05d9e3: Lightkeeper sees Ref’s weakness as useful leverage. Recover the old champion’s evidence and give it to him rather than Ref or Fence.

68400926706e0a55e90b0007: Skier intercepted the AK-50 handguard and knows exactly how badly Mechanic wants it. Pay his outrageous, non-negotiable price if you want the project to continue.
68400953506db3b4db0700e7: After taking his fee, Skier dumps the AK-50 handguard at an abandoned Woods sawmill. Reach the stash before someone else does and carry the part back into Mechanic’s project.
6863cf925eaeb676d50a9651: Mechanic’s gifted programmer friend vanished after the war began and may still be trapped in Tarkov. Search the Reserve offices where he served for any sign of what happened.
6863d9bcd3bfdcb2bc075956: A memory points Mechanic toward his friend’s long-delayed Health Resort trip and a secret meeting. Search the resort for his phone or another lead.
6863e09a5f4d17fd3e01feee: The programmer anticipated trouble and hid answers in a diary. Question Shoreline’s Scavs the Tarkov way, follow the clue they carry and recover the missing notebook.
686403eeb4aaef121c0f0f06: Mechanic can crack the phone and diary eventually, but failing hardware is slowing him down. Bring fresh computer components so he can finish the decryption now rather than tomorrow.
